about: Zip archives from three writers that are not Bun, and what Python's zipfile reads from each one, written as the lines of the readZip hook of bun:internal-for-testing. Recorded on Linux with TZ=UTC. To record again: run the three scripts of `made_with` in an empty directory with a directory `out` in it (the Go one with the path of its output as its argument), then `read_with`.

made_with.Python 3.13.5, zipfile:
# Archives from Python's zipfile. Fixed times, so that the bytes do not change from run to run.
import io, zipfile, stat
T = (2024, 2, 29, 13, 37, 42)
def info(name, mode=None, kind=stat.S_IFREG, compress=zipfile.ZIP_STORED):
    i = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=T)
    i.compress_type = compress
    if mode is not None:
        i.create_system = 3
        i.external_attr = (kind | mode) << 16
        if kind == stat.S_IFDIR:
            i.external_attr |= 0x10
    else:
        i.create_system = 0
        i.external_attr = 0x10 if name.endswith('/') else 0
    return i
text = ''.join('line %d of a text that DEFLATE makes smaller\n' % n for n in range(70)).encode()

with zipfile.ZipFile('out/python-basic.zip', 'w') as z:
    z.comment = b'made by zipfile'
    z.writestr(info('stored.txt'), b'stored as it is\n')
    z.writestr(info('deflated.txt', compress=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED), text)
    z.writestr(info('dir/'), b'')
    z.writestr(info('dir/sub/deep.txt'), b'deep\n')
    z.writestr(info('empty'), b'')
    z.writestr(info('\u00fcn\u00ef/c\u00f6d\u00e9.txt', compress=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED), 'a name in UTF-8\n'.encode())

with zipfile.ZipFile('out/python-unix-modes.zip', 'w') as z:
    z.writestr(info('run.sh', 0o755), b'#!/bin/sh\n')
    z.writestr(info('secret', 0o600), b's3cret\n')
    z.writestr(info('private/', 0o700, stat.S_IFDIR), b'')
    z.writestr(info('private/inside.txt', 0o644), b'inside\n')
    z.writestr(info('link', 0o777, stat.S_IFLNK), b'private/inside.txt')

class Unseekable(io.RawIOBase):
    def __init__(self): self.buf = io.BytesIO()
    def writable(self): return True
    def write(self, b): return self.buf.write(b)
    def seekable(self): return False
u = Unseekable()
with zipfile.ZipFile(u, 'w') as z:
    z.writestr(info('streamed.txt', compress=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED), text)
    with z.open(info('streamed-zip64.txt', compress=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED), 'w', force_zip64=True) as f:
        f.write(text)
    z.writestr(info('streamed-stored.txt'), b'stored, with the sizes behind the data\n')
open('out/python-streamed.zip', 'wb').write(u.buf.getvalue())

with zipfile.ZipFile('out/python-zip64-forced.zip', 'w') as z:
    with z.open(info('forced.txt', compress=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED), 'w', force_zip64=True) as f:
        f.write(text)
    z.writestr(info('plain.txt'), b'plain\n')

b = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(b, 'w') as z:
    z.writestr(info('inside.txt', compress=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED), text)
open('out/python-behind-a-program.zip', 'wb').write(b'#!/bin/sh\nexec unzip -p "$0" inside.txt\n' + b.getvalue())
